about: Which tier handles which kind of work in this project. tier: fast, standard or deep; each tool maps tiers to its own models. A rule may give an exact 'model' instead of a 'tier'. If several rules fit a task, the stronger tier wins; if none fit, the built-in rubric decides.

rules.when: reasoning, architecture and design tradeoffs, concurrency and race conditions, security, auth, payments, data integrity, complex algorithms, bugs that already failed once, unclear requirements
features with a clear spec, API endpoints, CRUD, refactors with a known shape, integrating existing pieces
renames, formatting, boilerplate, simple tests following existing patterns, docs, comments
